diff --git a/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/VPlan/vplan-simplify-recipes.ll b/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/VPlan/vplan-simplify-recipes.ll
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..d78c6512d9ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/VPlan/vplan-simplify-recipes.ll
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+; Test the simplify-recipes VPlan transform that simplifies recipe patterns.
+
+; RUN: opt -passes='vplan-test<create-loop-regions;widen-from-metadata;simplify-recipes>' -disable-output %s | FileCheck %s
+
+; Check that 'or %val, 0' is simplified, so store uses %val directly.
+; CHECK-LABEL: VPlan ' for UF>=1' {
+; CHECK: <x1> vector loop: {
+; CHECK:   vector.body:
+; CHECK:     EMIT ir<%val> = load ir<%gep>
+; CHECK:     EMIT store ir<%val>, ir<%gep>
+; CHECK:   No successors
+; CHECK: }
+
+define void @test_simplify(ptr %A, i64 %N) {
+entry:
+  br label %loop
+
+loop:
+  %iv = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop ]
+  %gep = getelementptr i32, ptr %A, i64 %iv
+  %val = load i32, ptr %gep
+  ; Identity: or X, 0 -> X (should be simplified away)
+  %result = or i32 %val, 0, !vplan.widen !{}
+  store i32 %result, ptr %gep
+  %iv.next = add i64 %iv, 1
+  %cmp = icmp slt i64 %iv.next, %N
+  br i1 %cmp, label %loop, label %exit
+
+exit:
+  ret void
+}

top_candidates.subject: [VPlan] Fix masked_cond expansion.
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: Fixes masked_cond expansion in VPlanTransforms::convertToConcreteRecipes by reversing the operands supplied to a newly created VPInstruction::LogicalAnd, placing the VPlan mask before operand zero. Corresponding LoopVectorize predicated early-exit tests update expected vector select operands, demonstrating that the change affects mask/condition expansion semantics in generated vector IR.
Changed symbols: VPlanTransforms::convertToConcreteRecipes; VPInstruction::LogicalAnd; three_early_exits; single_exit_in_conditional_block; diamond_with_2_early_exits
Behavioral change: Changes construction of a VPInstruction::LogicalAnd from operands {VPI->getOperand(0), VPI->getMask()} to {VPI->getMask(), VPI->getOperand(0)}.; Changes expected generated vector IR for predicated exits so the first operand of affected select instructions is the prior condition value rather than the prior mask value.; Does not add, erase, move, or reorder VPRecipeBase objects in the retrieved hunk; it changes operands of one newly constructed logical-and instruction.
Assertion or trace link: VPlan; VPInstruction::LogicalAnd; convertToConcreteRecipes
Reproducer link: The updated tests cover predicated single-exit, multiple-exit, and interleaved early-exit LoopVectorize cases.; No retrieved hunk references crash-62b480.cpp, a Clang -O3 assertion, phi-like recipes, or a "Found phi-like recipe after non-phi recipe" diagnostic.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlanTransforms; predicated early-exit vectorization
Causal explanation: This is a production VPlan transformation change and therefore has subsystem proximity to the issue. However, the evidence is limited to correcting LogicalAnd operand roles during masked-condition concretization and updating predicated-exit output checks. There is no retrieved evidence that it changes VPlan recipe-list ordering, phi-like recipe insertion, SmallVector storage, or vectorizer plan construction ordering, so the connection to the reported ordering assertion is indirect.
Causal confidence: 0.11
Build risk: Small implementation change using existing VPInstruction operands and mask accessors; no new API or dependency is introduced.; Updates several exact-output LoopVectorize tests, indicating a deliberate generated-IR semantic change for predicated early-exit cases.

diff --git a/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll b/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll
index e15d4fde3d70..f54f6ec768bc 100644
--- a/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll
+++ b/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll
@@ -715,0 +716,135 @@ loop.end:
+
+; When the else branch is speculatively executed for iv < 2, `sub nuw` wraps
+; producing poison. This poison condition is processed first in RPO.
+; Test for https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/187061.
+define i32 @diamond_exit_poison_from_speculated_branch() {
+; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @diamond_exit_poison_from_speculated_branch() {
+; CHECK-NEXT:  [[ENTRY:.*:]]
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[VECTOR_PH:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_PH]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[VECTOR_BODY:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_BODY]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP0:%.*]] = freeze <4 x i1> <i1 poison, i1 poison, i1 true, i1 true>
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP1:%.*]] = call i1 @llvm.vector.reduce.or.v4i1(<4 x i1> [[TMP0]])
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br i1 [[TMP1]], label %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_CHECK:.*]], label %[[MIDDLE_BLOCK:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[MIDDLE_BLOCK]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[LOOP_END:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_CHECK]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[FIRST_ACTIVE_LANE:%.*]] = call i64 @llvm.experimental.cttz.elts.i64.v4i1(<4 x i1> <i1 poison, i1 poison, i1 true, i1 true>, i1 false)
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP2:%.*]] = extractelement <4 x i1> <i1 poison, i1 poison, i1 false, i1 false>, i64 [[FIRST_ACTIVE_LANE]]
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br i1 [[TMP2]], label %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_0:.*]], label %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_1:.*]]

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit relands LoopVectorize support for vectorizing overflow intrinsics. It reinstates selective overload-type construction for struct-return vector intrinsics in VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe::execute and adds or updates tests showing vectorized uadd/sadd-with-overflow calls, vector struct returns, extractvalue operations, and vector-loop control flow.
Changed symbols: VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe::execute; isVectorIntrinsicWithStructReturnOverloadAtField; test_overflow_intrinsic; uadd_with_overflow_i32; sadd_with_overflow_i32
Behavioral change: VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe::execute again filters contained struct-return types and includes only fields requiring a vector-intrinsic overload type in TysForDecl.; LoopVectorize is expected to widen supported overflow intrinsics into vector calls returning structures such as { <N x i32>, <N x i1> }.; New and updated tests expect vector extraction of result and overflow fields, vector stores, vector-loop bodies, and middle-block exits instead of scalar overflow-intrinsic loops.; The AArch64 generated-check filter again includes with.overflow cases.
Assertion or trace link: VPlanRecipes; LoopVectorize; No literal "Found phi-like recipe after non-phi recipe" assertion or equivalent ordering diagnostic appears in the retrieved hunks.

Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan recipe execution; Widened struct-return intrinsic handling

Nevertheless, the visible implementation hunk only changes overload-type selection during VPWidenIntrinsicRecipe execution, while the target assertion concerns ordering phi-like recipes against non-phi recipes. No shown code constructs, inserts, moves, or reorders phi-like recipes, making the causal connection indirect.

steps.subject: [VPlan] Fix masked_cond expansion.

evidence: Changes only operand order when expanding a masked conditional into LogicalAnd.
It affects VPlan concrete-recipe conversion but not recipe list placement, phi-like recipes, or the recipe-order verifier.
features: logical-and, masked-condition, meta:core-llvm, path:llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize, path:llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize, poison-semantics
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This VPlan fix changes the operand order used when concretizing a masked conditional: the LogicalAnd recipe is now created from the mask followed by the condition operand, rather than condition followed by mask. Corresponding LoopVectorize early-exit and predicated-exit test expectations are updated to reflect the resulting select-mask ordering.
Changed symbols: VPlanTransforms::convertToConcreteRecipes; VPInstruction::LogicalAnd
Behavioral change: Masked conditional expansion now constructs LogicalAnd with {mask, condition} instead of {condition, mask}.; Generated vector select conditions for predicated early-exit tests change operand order to match corrected masked-condition semantics.
Assertion or trace link: VPlan; VPRecipe; LoopVectorize
Reproducer link: The candidate updates predicated single- and multiple-early-exit LoopVectorize tests, but no retrieved candidate hunk references crash-62b480.cpp or reproduces a phi-like-after-non-phi assertion.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan concrete-recipe conversion; predicated early-exit vectorization
Causal explanation: The change is in an affected VPlan transformation and changes recipe operands during conversion to concrete recipes, so it can alter VPlan expansion behavior. However, the visible modification does not insert or reorder recipes, does not mention phi-like recipes, and targets masked-condition correctness rather than the asserted ordering invariant. The older distance-4 poison-propagation test hunk is context only and is not attributed to this candidate.
Causal confidence: 0.14
Build risk: The implementation change is a one-line operand-order reversal in VPlanTransforms.; Several LoopVectorize predicated early-exit test expectations are updated, providing focused regression coverage for changed output semantics.; No direct crash signal, assertion text, SmallVector storage change, or supplied-reproducer coverage is present in the candidate hunks.

+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_1]]:

+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[LOOP_END]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_0]]:

+; CHECK:       [[UNREACHABLE_EXIT]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    call void @llvm.trap()

+  %iv = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop.latch ]
+  %cmp = icmp ult i32 %iv, 2
+  br i1 %cmp, label %then, label %else
+
+then:
+  %lo.val = add i32 %iv, 10
+  br label %loop.exiting

+  %trap.cond = icmp eq i32 %shl, 999
+  br i1 %trap.cond, label %unreachable.exit, label %loop.exiting

+unreachable.exit:

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This VPlan fix changes the operand order used when concretizing a masked conditional: the LogicalAnd recipe is now created from the mask followed by the condition operand, rather than condition followed by mask. Corresponding LoopVectorize early-exit and predicated-exit test expectations are updated to reflect the resulting select-mask ordering.
Changed symbols: VPlanTransforms::convertToConcreteRecipes; VPInstruction::LogicalAnd
Behavioral change: Masked conditional expansion now constructs LogicalAnd with {mask, condition} instead of {condition, mask}.; Generated vector select conditions for predicated early-exit tests change operand order to match corrected masked-condition semantics.
Assertion or trace link: VPlan; VPRecipe; LoopVectorize
Reproducer link: The candidate updates predicated single- and multiple-early-exit LoopVectorize tests, but no retrieved candidate hunk references crash-62b480.cpp or reproduces a phi-like-after-non-phi assertion.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan concrete-recipe conversion; predicated early-exit vectorization
Causal explanation: The change is in an affected VPlan transformation and changes recipe operands during conversion to concrete recipes, so it can alter VPlan expansion behavior. However, the visible modification does not insert or reorder recipes, does not mention phi-like recipes, and targets masked-condition correctness rather than the asserted ordering invariant. The older distance-4 poison-propagation test hunk is context only and is not attributed to this candidate.
Causal confidence: 0.14
Build risk: The implementation change is a one-line operand-order reversal in VPlanTransforms.; Several LoopVectorize predicated early-exit test expectations are updated, providing focused regression coverage for changed output semantics.; No direct crash signal, assertion text, SmallVector storage change, or supplied-reproducer coverage is present in the candidate hunks.

diff --git a/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll b/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll
index e15d4fde3d70..f54f6ec768bc 100644
--- a/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll
+++ b/llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize/predicated-multiple-exits.ll
@@ -715,0 +716,135 @@ loop.end:
+
+; When the else branch is speculatively executed for iv < 2, `sub nuw` wraps
+; producing poison. This poison condition is processed first in RPO.
+; Test for https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/187061.
+define i32 @diamond_exit_poison_from_speculated_branch() {
+; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @diamond_exit_poison_from_speculated_branch() {
+; CHECK-NEXT:  [[ENTRY:.*:]]
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[VECTOR_PH:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_PH]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[VECTOR_BODY:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_BODY]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP0:%.*]] = freeze <4 x i1> <i1 poison, i1 poison, i1 true, i1 true>
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP1:%.*]] = call i1 @llvm.vector.reduce.or.v4i1(<4 x i1> [[TMP0]])
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br i1 [[TMP1]], label %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_CHECK:.*]], label %[[MIDDLE_BLOCK:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[MIDDLE_BLOCK]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[LOOP_END:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_CHECK]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[FIRST_ACTIVE_LANE:%.*]] = call i64 @llvm.experimental.cttz.elts.i64.v4i1(<4 x i1> <i1 poison, i1 poison, i1 true, i1 true>, i1 false)
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP2:%.*]] = extractelement <4 x i1> <i1 poison, i1 poison, i1 false, i1 false>, i64 [[FIRST_ACTIVE_LANE]]
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br i1 [[TMP2]], label %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_0:.*]], label %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_1:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_1]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[TMP3:%.*]] = extractelement <4 x i32> <i32 10, i32 11, i32 1, i32 2>, i64 [[FIRST_ACTIVE_LANE]]
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[LOOP_END]]
+; CHECK:       [[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_0]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    br label %[[UNREACHABLE_EXIT:.*]]
+; CHECK:       [[UNREACHABLE_EXIT]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    call void @llvm.trap()
+; CHECK-NEXT:    unreachable
+; CHECK:       [[LOOP_END]]:
+; CHECK-NEXT:    [[RETVAL:%.*]] = phi i32 [ [[TMP3]], %[[VECTOR_EARLY_EXIT_1]] ], [ -1, %[[MIDDLE_BLOCK]] ]
+; CHECK-NEXT:    ret i32 [[RETVAL]]
+;
+entry:
+  br label %loop.header
+
+loop.header:
+  %iv = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop.latch ]
+  %cmp = icmp ult i32 %iv, 2
+  br i1 %cmp, label %then, label %else
+
+then:
+  %lo.val = add i32 %iv, 10
+  br label %loop.exiting
+
+else:
+  %sub = sub nuw i32 %iv, 2
+  %shl = shl nuw i32 1, %sub
+  %trap.cond = icmp eq i32 %shl, 999
+  br i1 %trap.cond, label %unreachable.exit, label %loop.exiting
+
+unreachable.exit:
+  call void @llvm.trap()
+  unreachable
+
+loop.exiting:
+  %val = phi i32 [ %lo.val, %then ], [ %shl, %else ]
+  %found.cond = icmp ult i32 %val, 12
+  br i1 %found.cond, label %loop.end, label %loop.latch
+
+loop.latch:
+  %iv.next = add nuw nsw i32 %iv, 1
+  %done = icmp eq i32 %iv.next, 4
+  br i1 %done, label %loop.end, label %loop.header
+
+loop.end:
+  %retval = phi i32 [ %val, %loop.exiting ], [ -1, %loop.latch ]
+  ret i32 %retval
+}
+

+; the then branch (RPO-before else).

top_candidates.subject: [VPlan] Sink single-scalar replicates in licm (#187047)
top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This VPlan LICM change permits sinking unpredicated VPReplicateRecipe instances when they have already been narrowed to single-scalar form. Previously all replicate recipes were excluded from sinking; now only non-single-scalar replicates remain excluded, with assertions documenting that predicated replicates must already have been converted to replicate regions.
Changed symbols: licm; VPReplicateRecipe; VPReplicateRecipe::isPredicated; VPReplicateRecipe::isSingleScalar
Behavioral change: VPlan LICM can now move single-scalar unpredicated replicate recipes into later VPlan blocks.; Predicated replicates are asserted to have been transformed into replicate regions before this LICM path.; Non-single-scalar replicates remain unsunk because replicateByVF is documented as not handling their sunk form correctly under unrolling.
Assertion or trace link: VPlan; VPRecipe; phi; LoopVectorize
Reproducer link: Updated tests cover vectorized recurrence, LCSSA/exit-phi, IV-outside-user, and uniform-operation output placement; they do not include the reported crash-62b480.cpp failure or the exact ordering assertion.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan LICM; VPReplicateRecipe handling
Causal explanation: This candidate directly changes VPlan recipe movement. The retrieved LICM context shows sunk candidates are moved before a destination block's first non-phi recipe, making recipe placement and phi boundaries relevant to the reported invariant. Although the new eligibility is restricted to single-scalar unpredicated replicates and the visible code attempts to preserve placement relative to phi recipes, enabling previously forbidden movement could expose an ordering interaction in plan construction or transformation. There is still no direct evidence of the reported assertion, exact reproducer, or SmallVector-backed storage failure.
Causal confidence: 0.34
Build risk: The change broadens VPlan LICM eligibility for VPReplicateRecipe, affecting recipe placement and generated LoopVectorize IR.; The implementation adds explicit assertions and retains a guard for unsupported non-single-scalar replicates.; Multiple LoopVectorize tests change expected placement of scalar computations, including LCSSA and recurrence-related cases.; No retrieved hunk directly contains the reported phi-like-after-non-phi assertion or the supplied C++ reproducer.

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This VPlan change fixes preservation of integer no-wrap flags while unrolling widened inductions. It adds accessors for no-wrap flags, obtains fast-math and wrap flags from the widened-induction recipe rather than only from the underlying induction instruction, and reuses the accessor when constructing the explicit-vector-length current-iteration increment. The accompanying LoopVectorize tests now expect propagated nsw flags on unrolled vector induction steps.
Changed symbols: hasNoWrapFlags; getNoWrapFlags; UnrollState::unrollWidenInductionByUF; VPlanTransforms::addExplicitVectorLength
Behavioral change: Unrolling a VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe now propagates its fast-math and integer no-wrap flags to generated unrolled induction operations.; Explicit-vector-length iteration increments obtain no-wrap flags through CanonicalIVIncrement::getNoWrapFlags rather than reconstructing the pair at the call site.; Generated vector induction-step adds are expected to retain nsw in affected LoopVectorize tests.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan; VPlan unrolling; VPlan explicit-vector-length transforms

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This change fixes narrow-interleave-group handling by materializing the vector trip count using the narrowed induction step, propagating that step through VFxUF uses, and restricting the transformation to supported middle-block CFG shapes. It also changes vector-trip-count insertion so that generated recipes are placed after a non-default Step definition, preserving def-use order, and adds regression coverage for epilogue vectorization with a preheader phi.
Changed symbols: VPlanTransforms::narrowInterleaveGroups; VPlanTransforms::materializeVectorTripCount; LoopVectorizationPlanner::executePlan
Behavioral change: narrowInterleaveGroups computes a narrowed Step, materializes the vector trip count using that Step, updates the induction increment, and replaces uses of Plan.getVFxUF() with the narrowed Step.; The transform now accepts a scalar-epilogue middle-block shape in addition to the prior two-successor shape and bails out for unsupported tail-folding shapes.; materializeVectorTripCount inserts after Step's defining recipe when Step is locally defined in the vector preheader, rather than always at the beginning of that block.; LoopVectorizationPlanner::executePlan passes BestVPlan.getVFxUF() to the scalar-epilogue setup path.; New LoopVectorize tests cover a no-crash epilogue-vectorization case involving an interleave group and a preheader phi.
Assertion or trace link: VPlan; VPBasicBlock recipe insertion; phi; The retrieved hunks do not contain the exact "Found phi-like recipe after non-phi recipe" assertion.
Reproducer link: The added test explicitly states that LoopVectorize should not crash when connecting an epilogue vector loop for an interleave group with a preheader phi.; That is not the supplied crash-62b480.cpp attachment, but it is a closely related no-crash scenario involving VPlan construction, vector-loop connection, and phi placement.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan transforms; epilogue vectorization; narrow interleave-group transformation
Causal explanation: This is the strongest retrieved connection because it changes recipe insertion position in a VPlan block and adds an explicit LoopVectorize no-crash test involving a preheader phi and epilogue-vector-loop connection. Inserting generated trip-count recipes after a Step definition can change local recipe ordering; the implementation asserts the Step is in the vector preheader and documents preservation of def-use order, but it does not explicitly enforce the reported phi-like-before-non-phi invariant. The test demonstrates a crash-related nearby scenario, though not the reported assertion or attachment.
Causal confidence: 0.58

steps.subject: [VPlan] Optimize FindLast of (binop %IV, live-in) by sinking. (#183911)

evidence: Adds VPlan optimization logic that creates and rewires select, reduction, and scalar reconstruction recipes.
It mutates plan recipe graphs but primarily introduces non-phi recipes and lacks a direct phi-ordering mechanism.
features: find-last-reduction, meta:core-llvm, path:llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize, path:llvm/test/Transforms/LoopVectorize, recipe-insertion, term:clonebinopforscalariv
selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit extends VPlanTransforms::optimizeFindIVReductions to recognize find-last expressions formed from a widened induction variable and a live-in value, track the underlying IV through the reduction, reconstruct the scalar expression after reduction, and use the reconstructed value in select/any-of reduction results. It also adds or updates find-last epilogue vectorization tests.
Changed symbols: VPlanTransforms::optimizeFindIVReductions; getExpressionIV; cloneBinOpForScalarIV; vputils::getSCEVExprForVPValue; VPBuilder::createSelect; VPBuilder::createNaryOp
Behavioral change: The transform identifies a sinkable expression of a widened IV and uses the underlying IV for ScalarEvolution/AddRec analysis.; When such an expression is found, the transform creates a replacement loop select that carries the underlying IV rather than the original expression.; The reduction is formed from the updated FindLastSelect, then cloneBinOpForScalarIV recreates the original scalar expression after the reduction.; Final select and ComputeAnyOfResult construction use VectorRegionExitingVal, which may be the post-reduction reconstructed expression.
Assertion or trace link: The commit inserts VPlan recipes through VPBuilder::createSelect and createNaryOp while transforming a reduction/select structure.; No retrieved hunk directly references phi-like recipes, the "Found phi-like recipe after non-phi recipe" assertion, or SmallVector-backed recipe storage.
Reproducer link: The included tests exercise find-last IV-expression cases, including an epilogue-vectorization case.; No retrieved test uses crash-62b480.cpp or demonstrates the reported assertion.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan; VPlanTransforms; find-last IV reduction optimization
Causal explanation: The commit is relevant because it mutates VPlan recipe graphs and inserts new select/reduction-related recipes near an existing select, so it could expose ordering-sensitive VPlan invariants in affected find-last reduction loops. The evidence is weaker for the specific report: the visible change creates non-phi select and reduction recipes rather than phi-like recipes, and the available tests target find-last expression sinking rather than the reported crash.
Causal confidence: 0.45

Summary: This changes scalar-VF replicate-region handling in VPlanUnroll. It enables replicate regions with live-outs to be dissolved for scalar VF, avoids extracting lane zero when VF is scalar, and replaces a VPPredInstPHIRecipe with a newly built scalar VPPhi using poison plus the original predicate operand. It also adds scalar-VF-only routing through replicateReplicateRegionsByVF and updates scalarization/dissolve-region test expectations.

Summary: This VPlan change teaches VPInstruction handling to identify the called-function operand of call recipes, uses that identification to compute call operand counts consistently, and classifies calls as memory-reading/writing unless their callee has doesNotAccessMemory. top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This VPlan change teaches VPInstruction handling to identify the called-function operand of call recipes, uses that identification to compute call operand counts consistently, and classifies calls as memory-reading/writing unless their callee has doesNotAccessMemory. It also adjusts dereferenceable-load analysis to stop at VPIR basic blocks and asserts that non-load recipes encountered there do not read memory; accompanying tests add early-exit loops containing unary operations and call-like intrinsics.
Changed symbols: getCalledFnOperandIndex; getCalledFunction; VPInstruction::getNumOperandsForOpcode; VPInstruction::opcodeMayReadOrWriteFromMemory; areAllLoadsDereferenceable; early_exit_with_fneg; early_exit_with_extractvalue
Behavioral change: For VPInstruction call recipes, determines whether the callee is the final operand or the penultimate operand when a mask is present.; Uses the identified callee position to calculate the number of non-mask operands for call recipes.; Treats a call recipe as potentially reading or writing memory unless the called function is marked doesNotAccessMemory.; Stops areAllLoadsDereferenceable traversal at VPIRBasicBlock instances as well as the middle block.; Adds an assertion that a non-load recipe inspected by areAllLoadsDereferenceable is not memory-reading.
Assertion or trace link: VPlan; VPInstruction; assert; memory-reading recipe
Reproducer link: New tests exercise LoopVectorize early-exit plans containing fneg and llvm.smul.with.overflow calls.; No retrieved evidence mentions the reported diagnostic "Found phi-like recipe after non-phi recipe", recipe ordering, SmallVector-backed storage, or crash-62b480.cpp.
Pass or subsystem link: LoopVectorize; VPlan construction; VPInstruction recipe analysis
Causal explanation: The commit changes production VPlan behavior and can alter how call recipes participate in memory/dereferenceability analysis, so it is within the relevant subsystem. Nevertheless, the shown changes classify calls and bound load analysis; they neither insert nor reorder phi-like recipes, nor modify recipe-list storage. The new assertion concerns unexpected memory-reading recipes rather than phi-like recipes following non-phi recipes, leaving only an indirect link to the reported failure.
Causal confidence: 0.18
Build risk: Introduces operand-position assertions for call VPInstructions; plans with an unexpected non-function final or penultimate operand can assert.; Introduces an assertion in dereferenceability analysis for non-load recipes that report memory reads.; Adds LoopVectorize regression tests for early-exit vectorization involving call-like operations.

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+; RUN: opt < %s -passes=loop-vectorize -disable-output -debug-only=loop-vectorize 2>&1 | FileCheck %s
+; REQUIRES: asserts
+target triple = "aarch64"
+
+; CHECK: Cost of 1 for VF 2: EMIT vp<{{.*}}> = first-order splice
+; CHECK: Cost of 3 for VF vscale x 2: EMIT vp<{{.*}}> = first-order splice
+
+define void @foo(ptr noalias %in, ptr noalias %out, i64 %n) "target-features"="+sve" {
+entry:
+  %load.prev = load i64, ptr %in, align 8
+  br label %for.body
+
+for.body:
+  %indvars.iv = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %indvars.iv.next, %for.body ]
+  %prev = phi i64 [ %load.prev, %entry ], [ %load.cur, %for.body ]
+  %indvars.iv.next = add nuw nsw i64 %indvars.iv, 1
+  %arrayidx.load = getelementptr inbounds nuw i64, ptr %in, i64 %indvars.iv.next
+  %load.cur = load i64, ptr %arrayidx.load
+  %add = add i64 %load.cur, %prev
+  %arrayidx.store = getelementptr inbounds nuw i64, ptr %out, i64 %indvars.iv
+  store i64 %add, ptr %arrayidx.store
+  %exitcond.not = icmp eq i64 %indvars.iv.next, %n
+  br i1 %exitcond.not, label %for.cond.cleanup, label %for.body, !llvm.loop !0
+
+for.cond.cleanup:
+  ret void
+}
+
+!0 = distinct !{!0, !1, !2}
+!1 = !{!"llvm.loop.mustprogress"}
+!2 = !{!"llvm.loop.unroll.disable"}

+; RUN: opt < %s -passes=loop-vectorize -disable-output -debug-only=loop-vectorize 2>&1 | FileCheck %s

+entry:
+  %load.prev = load i64, ptr %in, align 8
+  br label %for.body
+
+for.body:
+  %indvars.iv = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %indvars.iv.next, %for.body ]
+  %prev = phi i64 [ %load.prev, %entry ], [ %load.cur, %for.body ]
+  %indvars.iv.next = add nuw nsw i64 %indvars.iv, 1
+  %arrayidx.load = getelementptr inbounds nuw i64, ptr %in, i64 %indvars.iv.next
+  %load.cur = load i64, ptr %arrayidx.load
+  %add = add i64 %load.cur, %prev
+  %arrayidx.store = getelementptr inbounds nuw i64, ptr %out, i64 %indvars.iv
+  store i64 %add, ptr %arrayidx.store
+  %exitcond.not = icmp eq i64 %indvars.iv.next, %n
+  br i1 %exitcond.not, label %for.cond.cleanup, label %for.body, !llvm.loop !0

+  ret void

+!1 = !{!"llvm.loop.mustprogress"}

top_candidates.diff_summary:
Summary: This commit extends VPlan partial-reduction optimization to recognize absolute differences of equally extended inputs, abs(sub(ext(A), ext(B))), and rewrites them into a widened max/min/sub absolute-difference sequence followed by extension for the reduction. It also makes VPBuilder::insert return the inserted derived recipe pointer and adds AArch64 LoopVectorize/VPlan regression coverage showing the resulting reduction phi and newly created widening recipes.
Changed symbols: m_WidenIntrinsic; optimizeExtendsForPartialReduction; matchExtendedReductionOperand; VPBuilder::insert; unsigned_absolute_difference; signed_absolute_difference
Behavioral change: VPlan pattern matching now recognizes abs(sub(ext(A), ext(B))) as an eligible partial-reduction operand when the two source types and extension opcodes agree.; The partial-reduction transform inserts freeze recipes, signed or unsigned max/min widening intrinsics, and a subtract recipe, then zero-extends the absolute-difference result for the reduction.; VPBuilder::insert still inserts at the current insertion point, but now returns the inserted typed recipe pointer, enabling the new chained construction.; The added VPlan test expects a WIDEN-REDUCTION-PHI before the newly inserted WIDEN, WIDEN-INTRINSIC, and EXPRESSION recipes in the vector loop.
Assertion or trace link: No retrieved hunk contains the exact "Found phi-like recipe after non-phi recipe" assertion or an explicit change to the phi-like recipe ordering check.; The new VPlan test explicitly contains a WIDEN-REDUCTION-PHI followed by non-phi widening recipes, which is the ordering class implicated by the issue but is shown in valid order in this covered case.; Step-zero reachability is text-unreachable.
Reproducer link: The new unsigned_absolute_difference and signed_absolute_difference tests exercise LoopVectorize VPlan construction for partial reductions, including a reduction phi plus newly inserted non-phi recipes.; The retrieved tests do not include crash-62b480.cpp or establish that the issue reproducer has an absolute-difference partial reduction.

However, the visible implementation does not move or create phi-like recipes, does not change VPBasicBlock ordering enforcement, and its added VPlan expectation demonstrates the required phi-before-non-phi order for the covered path.

Summary: This reapplication changes reverse-access handling in VPlan: VPRecipeBuilder::tryToWidenMemory no longer passes the Reverse flag into widened load/store recipe constructors, optimizeMaskToEVL no longer excludes reverse widened memory operations from mask removal, and reverse or experimental_vp_reverse recipes are accounted for in costing. The shown EVL load construction also uses Addr instead of AdjustEndPtr(EndPtr), and boolean VP reverse-mask cost is made zero.

Summary: Moves VPlan constant-branch removal earlier and makes scalar-preheader handling tolerant of its absence. VPlanTransforms::removeBranchOnConst snapshots all plan blocks before CFG mutation so unreachable blocks can be recognized after branch folding. VPlan::execute and LoopVectorizationPlanner::executePlan now conditionally handle a scalar preheader, reflecting that early constant-branch removal can eliminate it. Existing LoopVectorize tests are updated to remove now-unnecessary merge PHIs with identical incoming values.
Changed symbols: VPlanTransforms::removeBranchOnConst; VPlan::execute; LoopVectorizationPlanner::executePlan

Summary: Removes the dedicated VPlan VPInstruction::ComputeAnyOfResult opcode and consolidates its handling into ComputeReductionResult. The change deletes the old opcode's type inference, unrolling special case, pattern matcher, IR generation, and enum entry, and adjusts reduction-result discovery in LoopVectorizationPlanner::addReductionResultComputation to expect ComputeReductionResult. The updated LoopVectorize test changes the expected reduction select from a constant-zero/zero select to a one/zero select.
Changed symbols: VPTypeAnalysis::inferScalarTypeForRecipe; LoopVectorizationPlanner::addReductionResultComputation; UnrollState::unrollBlock; VPInstruction::generate; VPInstruction::ComputeAnyOfResult; VPInstruction::ComputeReductionResult; m_ComputeAnyOfResult
Behavioral change: Eliminates the separate ComputeAnyOfResult recipe opcode and routes AnyOf-reduction result handling through ComputeReductionResult.; Removes special unroll-state treatment that marked ComputeAnyOfResult as uniform for all unrolled parts.; Changes reduction-result user matching so the planner only recognizes ComputeReductionResult rather than either ComputeAnyOfResult or ComputeReductionResult.; Removes ComputeAnyOfResult-specific IR generation, including its freeze-and-select implementation.

+

+// RUN: %clang --target=x86_64-linux-gnu -### \
+// RUN:   -s -u my_sym -rdynamic -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now %s 2>&1 | \
+// RUN:   FileCheck --check-prefix=PASS %s
+// PASS:      "-s"
+// PASS-SAME: "-export-dynamic"
+// PASS-SAME: "-u" "my_sym"
+// PASS-SAME: "-z" "relro" "-z" "now"
+
+/// -nopie is OpenBSD-specific.
+// RUN: not %clang -### --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu %s -nopie 2>&1 | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=CHECK-NOPIE
